caption: The drawing features a botanical composition with a variety of stylized flowers and leaves set against a light cream background. The central element is a large, blue flower with jagged petals, accented with green and yellow highlights and extending yellow-tipped pistils. Surrounding the main flower are several smaller blooms in shades of pink, brown, and soft yellow, each with delicate, radiating petals and green stems. The foliage is depicted in different shades of green, yellow, and brown, with some leaves having feathered or pointed shapes. Branches and stems curve organically throughout the image, predominantly in light brown and tan hues. At the top and edges of the drawing, additional segments of leaves and flowers in green, yellow, red, and blue extend partially into the frame, decorating the composition. The overall arrangement fills the image with natural, flowing lines and vibrant colors.
title: Crewel Bedspread
